notes.title: The Camera Update is now live!
notes.content:
Hey everyone! A new update is live, and it's awesome.

I like the idea of "inception" with cameras. In fact, I like it so much, that I decided to add it to the game.
So you can now have an object act as a camera, as well as have any other object display what it is that the former object sees.
This allows for really cool effects, and opportunities with building your worlds.

[i]Like this football stadium:[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42801252/37d80962777323a4e7f8e89053c09d2c239caf22.gif[/img]


Enjoy making really weird, and cursed creations with this awesome new feature!

-----------------------------------------------------------------

Before I get to the complete changelog that comes with this content update, I'd also like to share one of my favorite new features.
You can now move, rotate, and scale the default character rig in any way or form you like!
So...you can do this:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42801252/2119641bd8b1de2b0b26406acd63c1ea7d8f7117.gif[/img]

Yes, that is completely done in-game, and is [i]not[/i] edited afterwards.


[b]Complete changelog:[/b]

[i]Features[/i]
[list]
[*] You can now move, rotate, and scale the default character rig

[*] Made separate tabs for default properties, light properties, and camera properties

[*] Added the option to change light color, separate from regular color

[*] Added color palette selection back in

[*] Added ability to turn object into camera

[*] Added ability to have object display a camera (inception just became reality)

[*] Added FPS counter

[*] Added 3 new dances

[*] Added camera animations

[*] Added new achievements

[*] The game now saves whether an object is enabled/disabled

[*] There is now an intensity slider for the light property

[/list]

[i]Fixed:[/i]
[list]
[*] When pressing escape while in the options menu, if the properties panel is open, it will first close that, forcing you to press escape again to close the options menu

[*] You can no longer create multiple objects in the tutorial, which caused it to break completely and leaving the game softlocked

[*] Hierarchy now no longer shows the previously loaded project when starting a new one
[/list]


Please let me know if you stumble upon any weird bugs, and don't forget to share your creations on the workshop!

notes.content: Fixed objetcs resetting their rotation when being set as child of other object

notes.title: Changelog #2022-12-16
notes.content:
Hey everyone! 

A lot has been done in the past week! The main thing is transparency! You can now easily change an object's visibility to make things like windows or glasses!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42801252/cde2227b61acfd93f92ce151e1e88c5df7545ee0.gif[/img]

Full changelog:

Features

- Added transparency
- Added the ability the rebind the default movement keys
- Removed reset button and a bunch of anxiety that people would save an almost empty scene thinking it's a new one, while it's actually the original scene they reset
- Starting or restarting the tutorial will no reset the camera's position
- Build music, as well as dance is now randomized every time you switch between build mode and dance mode. I know, those 2 songs got annoying.
- Added reset buttons for position, rotation, and scale
- The game now saves/loads the last selected dance animation between savefiles and sessions


Fixes:

- You can no longer use delete key 1 while dancing
- You can no longer parent an object while dancing
- You can no longer spawn in an object at the exact same time as pressing space to dance
- Parenting from the hierarchy is no completely possible and no longer hides objects
- You can no longer save, load, or start a new character while following the tutorial
- You can no longer move, rotate, or scale objects while dancing by holding the left mouse button and pressing spacebar
- Fixed rotation bugs caused by tiny numbers in the inputfields

notes.title: Changelog #2022-12-11
notes.content:
- Added more instructions to tutorial on how to hide the default rig

- Duplicating objects now also duplicates their name for clarity

- Fix: Pressing escape while parenting an object no longer breaks the object's behaviour

- Fix: Tutorial should no longer unexpectedly get the game stuck in an infinite loop

notes.title: 🎉Dance Assembly has LAUNCHED!🎉
notes.content:
[h2][b][i]It's Launch Day![/i][/b][/h2]

Hey everyone,

It's finally here, after months of working hard! Dance Assembly is now available to buy!
Create your own characters using basic 3D shapes, and make them dance!

I'm super excited to see all you create! Don't forget to share them on the workshop (or even on Twitter! Tag me [url=https://twitter.com/TShelfman]@TShelfman[/url])


[h2][b][i]How I made this game[/i][/b][/h2]

If you're interested in watching a video in which I explain why, and how I made this game, be sure to check out this devlog I made!
[previewyoutube=_b-rCrTjWc8;full][/previewyoutube]

It would mean a lot if you could check it out!😁

[h2][b][i]What now?[/i][/b][/h2]
The game is out! But that doesn't mean I'm done with it! I plan to obviously fix bugs that never stop appearing, but I'll also be adding more features and more achievements with time. I still have a bunch of fun ideas!

Until then! Go make some awesome (or weird) dancers! I look forward to seeing them all.
Have a great day!

Sincerely,

TheShelfman

notes.title: Welcome to Dance Assembly💃
notes.content:
[h2]✨Hey there!✨[/h2]

A few months ago, I started working on a little game about creating your own character through basic 3D shapes, and making it do fun, and silly dances💃
[i]Fast-forward[/i] to today, the game is so much bigger than I expected, with quite a few awesome features that will make creating your dancers even crazier, and even more fun!

[h2]Some cool new features![/h2]
Before I get to the planned release date, let's talk about what cool new features I've been working on.
First of all, I added the ability to have objects [i]emit light[/i]. This way you can give your creation cool atmospheric lighting, if that's something that excites you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42801252/8c9c227964cf0329122f3cf099b9554ded313bf7.png[/img]


I've [b]also[/b] added a frequently requested feature: [i]Uniform scaling[/i]. Such a simple concept, but one I hadn't thought of myself. Now, when you hold SHIFT while scaling your creation, it will scale the entire object at once, on all sides. Great stuff![img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42801252/3a43a1257251633dd5e5eaeab0751c28d68462e3.gif[/img]


[h2][i]NOW! When can you expect Dance Assembly??[/i][/h2]

The game is mostly done. I've mostly got [strike]crying[/strike] bugfixing, and fun extra features left, but my main focus will be to create the game's release video for my [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCGFm2f0Q2k4qFbl6I7M86Bw]YouTube Channel[/url].
This will take quite a while, but I'm working towards releasing the game on Thursday, December 8th 2022.
I'll be sure to post some updates here and there, but that's what I have in mind for now!

For any questions, feel free to reach out. Until then, don't forget to wishlist the game!😁

I can't wait to see your dancers.

Sincerely,

TheShelfman
